summary_md: **Mrs. Truffle ([@VagabondTruffle](https://x.com/VagabondTruffle/status/2115513838741463119))** shares tuned benchmarks of **DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017** on a 2021 M1 Max (64 GB) using @Beamsters1's 1.75-bit Sushi STQ quant from Hugging Face; the screenshot shows the measured settings.
relevance: Extreme low-bit quant makes a frontier MoE usable on an older Mac.

media.description: 'Results on your M1 Max' table and bar charts comparing memory configs (40–48 GiB, DSpark speculative decoding on/off) on slots per layer, cache hit, prefill and decode tok/s and free memory for a cold 8.6K prompt; 42 GiB with DSpark off and 512K context is chosen (76 tok/s prefill, 5.2–5.4 tok/s decode, 6.3 GB free).
media.ocr_text:
Results on your M1 Max — Cold 8.6k prompt, 200-token decode, auto context.
44 GiB, DSpark on: 82 slots/layer, 85% cache hit, 73 prefill, 5.0–5.1 decode, 2.8 GB min available — DSpark accepted only about 0.2 drafts per round on your text
44 GiB, DSpark off: 92, 86%, 78, 5.6–6.5, 3.7 GB — 12–28% faster than DSpark on
48 GiB, DSpark off: 103, 90%, 46, 6.5–7.0, 1.6 GB — 26 GB compressed, about 5 GB swapped, prefill collapsed
40 GiB, DSpark off: 81, 84%, 75, 4.9–5.0, 8.1 GB
42 GiB, DSpark off, 512k: 86, 87%, 76, 5.2–5.4, 6.3 GB — chosen, matches your 6 GB headroom
